# printer-cli

> printer-cli (`prt`) controls network printers from the terminal: status, ink, alerts, nozzle checks, head cleaning, printing and scanning over IPP, eSCL, SNMP and Epson ESC/P2. It also prints a photo as a newspaper front page, wizard or sports card, certificate, or wanted, missing-pet or movie poster (`prt booth`), a greeting card that folds from one A4 sheet (`prt card`), 3 to 6 photos as a comic page with speech bubbles (`prt comic`), a four-frame photo-booth strip or a Polaroid-style instant photo on 4×6 photo paper (`prt strip`, `prt instant`), a photo as black line art on white for a colouring page (`prt colour-in`), a two-sided postcard with a photo front and a message, address and stamp-box back (`prt postcard`), a circular label with a photo and a track list on a printable CD/DVD through the disc tray (`prt disc`), a recipe as 4×6 index cards (`prt recipe URL`), a different bingo card for each player (`prt bingo --theme "road trip" -n 8`), a sudoku, word search, crossword or maze with its solution (`prt puzzle sudoku|wordsearch|crossword|maze`), a web article or X post as A4 magazine pages (`prt article`), photos as a vintage newspaper or a text-first morning edition (`prt gazette`), a git log as a commit receipt (`prt receipt`), and any page described as JSON blocks of headings, text, images, QR codes, columns and rules (`prt compose page.json`).

Install with `uv tool install printer-cli` (or `uv tool install 'printer-cli[mcp]'` for the MCP server). Add `-p demo` to any command to try it without a printer.

Notes for agents:

- `-f json` gives JSON on stdout, and on failure a `{"error": {"code", "kind", "message", "hint"}}` object on the last line of stderr. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime error, 2 usage error, 3 bad input, 130 interrupted.
- `prt styles -f json` lists every page style with its fields and character limits. `prt schema story|article|gazette|morning|page|card|comic|recipe|postcard|disc|bingo|wordsearch|crossword` prints the JSON Schema of each input file; `page` is the block format `prt compose` reads.
- `--preview FILE` renders without printing. The `-f json` line reports `fits` and `cut` (booth, card, comic, strip, instant, colour-in, postcard, disc, bingo, gazette, receipt) and an ink `estimate`. `--story-file -`, `--card-file -`, `--comic-file -`, `--postcard-file -`, `--disc-file -`, `--words-file -` (bingo, puzzle wordsearch), `--crossword-file -`, `prt article -`, `prt recipe -` and `prt compose -` read the input from stdin. An invalid page file is refused before anything is printed.
- `prt puzzle … -f json` reports the puzzle's `solution` and `seed`, and `--answers key.json` saves them, so a filled-in sheet scanned back with `prt scan --format jpeg` can be checked.
- Set `PRT_AGENT=1` so nothing prints without `--yes`. `max_pages_per_run` and `max_pages_per_day` in `~/.config/prt/config.toml` cap the pages, and in agent mode the per-run cap defaults to 10. `prt print --wait` and `prt jobs wait ID` wait for a job to finish.
- `prt mcp` is an MCP stdio server with the tools `status`, `ink`, `list_styles`, `preview_booth`, `preview_article` and `print_file`.
- `prt skills install --claude` (or `--agents`) installs the bundled agent skills. The repository is also a Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add luongnv89/printer-cli`, then `/plugin install printer-cli@printer-cli`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/README.md): the full user guide, with every command, the JSON error kinds, the agent guardrails, the MCP server and the configuration
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/AGENTS.md): using prt from an agent, and working on this repository

## Agent skills

- [photo-booth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/skills/photo-booth/SKILL.md): write a short story for a photo and print it as a newspaper front page, trading card, certificate or poster with `prt booth`
- [greeting-card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/skills/greeting-card/SKILL.md): write a verse for a photo and the occasion and print it as a greeting card that folds from one A4 sheet with `prt card`
- [article-print](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/skills/article-print/SKILL.md): print a blog post, news article or X post as magazine pages with `prt article`, fetching the text yourself when the command cannot
- [letter-gazette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/skills/letter-gazette/SKILL.md): scan a handwritten letter with `prt scan`, transcribe it, and print the scan and the transcription as a vintage newspaper edition with `prt gazette`
- [puzzle-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luongnv89/printer-cli/main/skills/puzzle-check/SKILL.md): print a sudoku, word search, crossword or maze with `prt puzzle` and keep its answers, then scan the filled-in sheet with `prt scan` and check it
